<?php

class Scanner {
    private $tokens = [];
    private $index = 0;

    public function __construct($stream) {
        $this->stream = $stream;
    }

    public function next() {
        while ($this->index >= count($this->tokens)) {
            $line = fgets($this->stream);
            if ($line === false) {
                return null;
            }
            $this->tokens = preg_split('/\s+/', trim($line));
            $this->index = 0;
        }
        return $this->tokens[$this->index++];
    }

    public function nextInt() {
        return intval($this->next());
    }

    public function nextLong() {
        return intval($this->next());
    }

    public function nextLine() {
        return fgets($this->stream);
    }

    public function nextDouble() {
        return floatval($this->next());
    }

    public static $sysIn;

}

Scanner::$sysIn = new Scanner(STDIN);

function main() {
    $sc = Scanner::$sysIn;

    $x = $sc->nextInt();
    $n = $sc->nextLong();

    $primes = [];

    function isPrime($k) {
        if ($k == 1) return false;
        if ($k == 2 || $k == 3) return true;
        for ($i = 2; $i <= intval(sqrt($k)); $i++) {
            if ($k % $i == 0) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    for ($i = 2; $i <= intval(sqrt($x)); $i++) {
        if ($x % $i == 0) {
            if (isPrime($i) && !in_array(intval($x / $i), $primes)) {
                $primes[] = $i;
            }
            if (isPrime(intval($x / $i)) && !in_array(intval($x / $i), $primes)) {
                $primes[] = intval($x / $i);
            }
        }
    }
    if (isPrime($x)) $primes[] = $x;

    $mod = 1000000007;

    function power($x, $p, $mod) {
        if ($p == 0) return 1;
        if ($p == 1) return $x % $mod;
        if ($p % 2 == 0) {
            $cur = power($x, intdiv($p, 2), $mod);
            return ($cur * $cur) % $mod;
        } else {
            return (power($x, $p - 1, $mod) * $x) % $mod;
        }
    }

    $ans = 1;

    foreach ($primes as $p) {
        $curP = intval($p);
        while (intdiv($n, $curP) > 0) {
            $ans = ($ans * power(intval($p), intdiv($n, $curP), $mod)) % $mod;
            if (intdiv($curP * $p, $p) != $curP) break;
            $curP *= $p;
        }
    }

    echo $ans . PHP_EOL;
}

main();

source_data.prob_desc_description: Let's introduce some definitions that will be needed later.Let $$$prime(x)$$$ be the set of prime divisors of $$$x$$$. For example, $$$prime(140) = \{ 2, 5, 7 \}$$$, $$$prime(169) = \{ 13 \}$$$.Let $$$g(x, p)$$$ be the maximum possible integer $$$p^k$$$ where $$$k$$$ is an integer such that $$$x$$$ is divisible by $$$p^k$$$. For example:  $$$g(45, 3) = 9$$$ ($$$45$$$ is divisible by $$$3^2=9$$$ but not divisible by $$$3^3=27$$$),  $$$g(63, 7) = 7$$$ ($$$63$$$ is divisible by $$$7^1=7$$$ but not divisible by $$$7^2=49$$$). Let $$$f(x, y)$$$ be the product of $$$g(y, p)$$$ for all $$$p$$$ in $$$prime(x)$$$. For example:  $$$f(30, 70) = g(70, 2) \cdot g(70, 3) \cdot g(70, 5) = 2^1 \cdot 3^0 \cdot 5^1 = 10$$$,  $$$f(525, 63) = g(63, 3) \cdot g(63, 5) \cdot g(63, 7) = 3^2 \cdot 5^0 \cdot 7^1 = 63$$$. You have integers $$$x$$$ and $$$n$$$. Calculate $$$f(x, 1) \cdot f(x, 2) \cdot \ldots \cdot f(x, n) \bmod{(10^{9} + 7)}$$$.
source_data.prob_desc_input_spec: The only line contains integers $$$x$$$ and $$$n$$$ ($$$2 \le x \le 10^{9}$$$, $$$1 \le n \le 10^{18}$$$) — the numbers used in formula.
source_data.prob_desc_notes: NoteIn the first example, $$$f(10, 1) = g(1, 2) \cdot g(1, 5) = 1$$$, $$$f(10, 2) = g(2, 2) \cdot g(2, 5) = 2$$$.In the second example, actual value of formula is approximately $$$1.597 \cdot 10^{171}$$$. Make sure you print the answer modulo $$$(10^{9} + 7)$$$.In the third example, be careful about overflow issue.
